title: [BUG]App freezes on "thinking" when using CrewAI Tracing
body: ### Description I recently started using [CrewAI Tracing](https://app.crewai.com/) to monitor my project. However, I noticed an issue: my project runs normally under usual conditions, but once I log in with `crewai login`, it gets stuck on the "thinking" state. Does anyone know what’s going on? Could this be caused by my network or proxy settings? ### Steps to Reproduce na ### Expected behavior na ### Screenshots/Code snippets ### Operating System Ubuntu 20.04 ### Python Version 3.10 ### crewAI Version 0.186.1 ### crewAI Tools Version 0.71.0 ### Virtual Environment Conda ### Evidence na ### Possible Solution na ### Additional context na

linked_prs.title: fix: fix double trace call; add types

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue describes the agent system freezing on the "thinking" state, which indicates a workflow anomaly (hanging agent loop) after integrating CrewAI Tracing. This aligns with the agent issue taxonomy under workflow issues.
